name: codex-environment-injector
description: Inject and inspect per-conversation Codex environments with Profiles, prompts, Memories policy, AGENTS guidance, permissions, and redacted proof.

interface.shortDescription: Manage and verify per-conversation Codex environments
interface.longDescription: Adds one pluggable Codex++ environment surface for Profile selection, direct-RPC prompt/config injection, injection proof, Memories policy and review, AGENTS drafts, migration, and rollback-safe installation.
defaultPrompt: Use $environment-injector to inspect the current conversation environment and injection proof.
Use $environment-injector to create or edit an environment Profile, memory policy, or AGENTS guidance.
Use $environment-injector to diagnose migration, direct-RPC injection, installation, or rollback.
